series_diffs: Candidate has slightly sharper wood-grain detailing and stronger micro-texture than the softer, simpler clay surfaces in several references.
Foreground fence and foliage are somewhat more visually dominant than comparable scene edges in the reference set.
The empty signboard resembles a UI/text placeholder, though it contains no readable text and does not violate the contract.
issues: Central enclosure elements are complete and clearly readable, but the lower foreground fence consumes substantial space and may reduce scene clarity on a small mobile crop.
The habitat is convincingly presented as an empty 'before' state, though the blank signboard may attract attention without communicating useful visual information.
